# ctrlplane_deployment_variable (Data Source)

Fetch an existing deployment variable by deployment ID and key within the configured workspace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment ID this variable belongs to
- `key` (String) The exact variable key to look up

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The variable description
- `id` (String) The ID of the deployment variable
